title: Surreal Cosmic Ritual
description: A man in a black hoodie stands inside a glowing blue circular portal with magical symbols, holding two orbs containing a red planet and multiple eyeballs. To the right, a tall pink monolith covered in black and white cow patterns drips with bright orange liquid, set against a dark sky with floating eyes and geometric shards.
